release_notes:
## ⚠️ For EE users, before upgrading to v2.6.0 finish existing Temporal workflow runs on v2.5.1

Appsmith is moving to a new workflow engine. Runs that started on the old Temporal engine cannot be relied on to resume or finish after upgrading to v2.6.0.

A **run** is one execution of a workflow. This includes executions waiting for a person to approve a request, even when they are not actively processing anything.

**What to do before upgrading:**

1. Upgrade to **v2.5.1** first if you are on an earlier version.
2. Let all runs on Temporal finish, including any waiting for approval. Stop a run only if you are willing to abandon its remaining work.
3. In **Admin Settings → Instance → Admin central**, review and acknowledge the **v2.5.0 · Workflow Engine Transition** checkpoint. Follow the [workflow engine transition guide](https://docs.appsmith.com/getting-started/setup/instance-management/upgrade-checkpoint-v2.5.0-temporal).
4. Upgrade to **v2.6.0**.

**Possible downtime:** the upgrade check can prevent the entire Appsmith server from starting if it finds pending approval requests from the old engine. Complete the steps above before upgrading; do not rely on the startup check to find every unfinished run.

If startup is blocked by this checkpoint, return to **v2.5.1**, finish or deliberately stop the affected runs, complete the checkpoint, and retry the upgrade.

## 🔐 Brotli security fix (CVE-2026-111497):

Appsmith v2.6.0 includes the fix for a vulnerability in the Node.js Brotli decoder. Processing maliciously crafted Brotli-compressed data can corrupt memory and potentially cause a service crash, expose process memory, or allow remote code execution. Self-hosted customers should upgrade to v2.6.0 to receive the fix. See the [Node.js security advisory](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases) for details.

## ⚠️ Important Upgrade Notes

- Customized `docker.env` files must contain resolved literal values. Shell expressions stop startup with a redacted diagnostic. Move JVM options from `docker.env` to Docker Compose or Helm environment configuration before upgrading. `OTEL_*` names, including the documented trace exporter endpoints, are now accepted. Generated defaults and Admin Settings values need no changes. ([#42225](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42225), [#42422](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42422))
- Redis queries must use a static command name. A binding in the command name returns a query configuration error. Binding values stay inside a single argument. ([#42465](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42465))
- The DynamoDB plugin now uses AWS SDK for Java 2.55.9. A region must contain only letters, digits, and hyphens, and be at most 63 characters. Responses can include additional keys; existing keys and values stay the same. If the server sets `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`, `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_DYNAMODB`, `AWS_USE_FIPS_ENDPOINT`, or `AWS_USE_DUALSTACK_ENDPOINT`, the plugin now honors them. ([#42346](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42346))

## 🔐 Security

- Updated bundled dependencies to address reported vulnerabilities. ([#42444](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42444), [#42449](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42449), [#42466](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42466), [#42475](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42475), [#42492](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42492))
- Editor-mode page and layout reads now require edit permission and return the draft. View mode still requires read permission and returns the published page. ([#42425](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42425))
- Updating an application or datasource now keeps the workspace it was created in. ([#42462](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42462))
- Creating a workspace now ignores a client-supplied id, policies, and permission groups. The server generates them. ([#42478](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42478))
- Redis query bindings stay inside one command argument, so a bound value cannot add extra arguments. ([#42465](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42465))

## 🛠️ Reliability

- Public apps again receive the configured Google Maps key, so Map widgets work for anonymous viewers. ([#42440](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42440))
- Saving datasource credentials now drops that datasource's cached connection on every server pod. ([#42430](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42430))
- Closing an evicted datasource connection no longer runs on the shared request thread, so one hung database no longer stalls health checks. ([#42450](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42450))
- Page views are recorded when a page is opened, not when the editor loads layout DSL. ([#42429](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42429))
- Nested DynamoDB request objects, including transaction items and index settings, are now built the same way every time. ([#42346](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42346))

## ✨ New Features & Enhancements

- MCP structured SQL filters can test `isNull` and `notNull`. ([#42491](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42491))
- MCP structured SQL filters can group conditions with `anyOf`, which compiles to OR and is combined with the other filters. ([#42495](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42495))
- MCP structured SQL `like` can match contains, prefix, suffix, or exact text. PostgreSQL queries can use `ilike`. ([#42496](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42496))

## 🎨 UI & Widget Improvements

- In App Settings → Navigation, **Show logo** and **Show application title** no longer switch themselves while a save is in progress. ([#42488](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42488))

## 🔧 Git, Deployment & Configuration

- `docker.env` now accepts `OTEL_*` names, including the documented OpenTelemetry trace exporter endpoints. An externally set `OTEL_*` value still overrides the file on restart. ([#42422](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42422))
- Browser telemetry is now sent for builders only. Anonymous visitors and end users of published apps are no longer tracked in the browser. ([#42353](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42353))
